premises.scope: For residual energy rho and transverse Gram G, an ORIGINAL-coordinate partition S,Y,Z satisfies rho_S M(G_Y,G_Z)>=(2/81)rho det G.

premises.claim: grouped projected-crossing theorem, one original hub plus ell=2
premises.scope: If the projected light crossing has Z_2>0 and every ell=2 volume row marginal is <=1/2, arbitrary internal hub/light quadratic terms are allowed and ||p_Q||infinity <=3*2^(7/6)*exp(1/3)(||w_J||^2 Z_2)^(-1/6), with C_0 density.

new_results.statement: In the live near-coloop state, the account04/B10 partition can be chosen so that after conditioning S, lambda_min(G_Y+G_Z)>=2/81, remaining longitudinal energy <=79rho/81, and the actual physical hub-star energy sum_{Y union Z}A_0i^2>1/47.
For an ORIGINAL leaf partition I,J, w_J=A_0J and C=A_IJ(I-Pi_w), ||w_J||^2 e_2(CC^T)=D^2 c det(G_I^perp)V_3(J); the ell=2 row marginal equals the normalized transverse pair-volume marginal.

If rho=1-c>0 and max leaf transverse row norm squared <1/61, there is an ORIGINAL partition satisfying the checked projected-crossing gates and ||p_Q||infinity<16.652 D^(-1/3)rho^(-1/6), with a continuous C_0 density, for arbitrary hub Rayleigh coefficient and all signatures.
Every certificate of the same disjoint one-hub/two-projected-crossing form satisfies ||w_J||^2 Z_2<=D^2 c rho because V_3(J)<=rho; this mechanism alone cannot yield a rho-uniform endpoint.
For cap-one f, F_{t,a}(beta)=int f(h)e^{it(ah^2+2beta h)}dh satisfies int|F_{t,a}(beta)|^2 dbeta=(pi/|t|)int f^2<=pi/|t| uniformly in a.

partner_application: rho_S M(G_Y,G_Z)>=(2/81)rho gives G_{Y union Z}>=2I/81 in the eigenvalue sense; combining this with sigma_min(M)>=1, |alpha|<1/16 and rho<1/64 gives ||A_{0,Y union Z}||_2^2>1/47.
next_step: Build a product-preserving joint receiver that uses the noncollapsing physical star and transverse curvature on overlapping original-coordinate banks, avoiding any disjoint leaf three-volume; exploit the hub chirp L2 identity jointly rather than taking a fiber supremum.
